response:
**When a Supabase project is paused, you’re in “paused” mode on the free tier.**

- **Your data isn’t deleted** – it stays in the database and files just as it was.
- The project is **not running** at the moment, so you can’t connect to it until you resume.
- Once you hit “Resume” (it’s a one‑click button in the Supabase dashboard), everything comes back exactly as it was: tables, rows, files, authentication, etc.

So: nothing is gone, you just can’t use it until you unpause.  
Just click “Resume” in the Supabase UI when you’re ready to use it again. If you want to be sure, you can also export a database backup before resuming, but normally you won’t need to – pausing is intentional and reversible.
